final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS mix, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref = t.transreg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_option_volume) AS overall_avg FROM step1) SELECT AVG(step1.avg_option_volume), AVG(step1.record_count), AVG(step1.avg_option_volume - step2.overall_avg) FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND step1.avg_option_volume > step2.overall_avg
